kurz: Yoghurt is milk soured by lactic acid bacteria. The acid thickens it, adds freshness and activates baking soda.
bild_im_kopf: Milk that bacteria have given a new shape.
was_passiert: Bacteria turn [[milchzucker|milk sugar]] into lactic acid. The acid makes the milk protein thicken into a soft gel.
faustregeln: Stir yoghurt into hot sauces only at the end, otherwise it curdles.
In a batter with baking soda: the yoghurt's acid makes the soda fizz and raises it.
